title: Photo Restoration Queue Age
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:photo format_type=* restoration_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(restoration_state!="done",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by format_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending restoration jobs backlog by format type for family-photo restoration.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside family-photo restoration.
implementation: Mark each `genealogy:photo` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `format_type`.
visualization: Table of format type with pending restoration jobs counts.
grandmaExplanation: It totals where unfinished restoration jobs are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in family-photo restoration.
